paper.title_en: Superdilations at Schwarzschild null infinity and beyond
paper.abstract_en: Relying on the definition of asymptotic conformal Killing horizons, the generators of asymptotic conformal symmetries at future null infinity in Schwarzschild space-time is computed. Supertranslations and superdilations are generated by two independent functions on the sphere, and the generators close an enlarged algebra with respect to the BMS one. For a generic asymptotically flat space-time, the superdilations Iyer-Wald charge is non-trivial but divergent at the boundaries of null infinity, where its growth rate is fixed by the asymptotic values of the Bondi mass aspect. Such a rate equals the monopole supertranslation charge, for which antipodal matching is well posed and trivially satisfied in the Schwarzschild geometry, where, furthermore, only the global dilation mode contributes. Its growth reflects the explicit time dependence of the generator rather than radiation. The effect of superdilations on a pair of celestial observers is an angle-dependent dilation rate, related to the local density of the charge.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在Schwarzschild时空中系统构造了渐近共形Killing视界及其生成元，提出超 dilatation 与超平移构成比BMS更大的代数，并讨论了Iyer-Wald荷在零无穷边界上的发散行为及其与单极超平移荷、对跖匹配和时间依赖性的关系，属于经典广义相对论渐近对称性与守恒荷的基础理论工作。虽然缺乏引用与期刊信息，但主题与索引范围高度相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: Schwarzschild 零无穷及更远处的超 dilatation
decision.abstract_zh: 依赖渐近共形 Killing 视界的定义，本文计算了 Schwarzschild 时空中未来零无穷处渐近共形对称性的生成元。超平移与超 dilatation 由球面上的两个独立函数生成，这些生成元闭合为一个相对于 BMS 代数扩大的代数。对于一般的渐近平坦时空，超 dilatation 的 Iyer-Wald 荷虽非平凡，但在零无穷的边界处发散，其增长率由 Bondi 质量纵横的渐近值固定。这一增长率等于单极超平移荷，该荷的对跖匹配适定良好，并在 Schwarzschild 几何中平凡地满足；此外在 Schwarzschild 几何中只有全局 dilatation 模式有贡献。其增长反映的是生成元显式的时间依赖性，而非辐射。超 dilatation 对一对天球观测者的效应是一个依赖于角度的 dilatation 速率，与该荷的局域密度相关。
